description: Age calculator — Exact age from a birth date: years/months/days, totals in days/weeks/months, next birthday (date, days until, weekday, age turning), birthday-today flag, born weekday and day of year, leap-day handling (leap=feb28 default or mar1), 18/21/65 thresholds and dates, US Social Security full retirement age and date, earliest benefits and Medicare dates, generation, western and Chinese zodiac, and day-count milestones. dob=YYYY-MM-DD required; optional on=YYYY-MM-DD reference date or tz= (IANA) for today. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: time_age
